answer_1.quote: We present a high-quality and large-scale Vietnamese-English parallel dataset, named PhoMT, that consists of 3.02M sentence pairs... we empirically investigate strong baselines on our dataset, including Transformer-base, Transformer-big and the pre-trained sequence-to-sequence denoising autoencoder mBART.

answer_2.quote: We report standard metrics TER and BLEU, in which lower TER and higher BLEU indicate better performances.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human-based manual comparison between the outputs generated by the two automatic translation systems and our three neural baselines... we ask three external Vietnamese annotators to choose which translation they think is the best.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to select the best translation among the five system outputs for each source sentence.
